item.title: Bulletin updated at 04:45 HKT 16/Sep/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will bring heavy showers and thunderstorms to southern China and the northern part of the South China Sea today. With the trough of low pressure weakening, showers will lessen and the weather will improve over the region in the next couple of days. A surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to affect the coast of southeastern China in the middle and latter parts of next week. The weather will be mainly fine during the day over the region.
